cases.name: Find the relevant Kimi experience inside a noisy evidence pack
cases.question: When did you start using Kimi and what do you like most about it? Share a real experience.

evidence.title: First serious Kimi workflow
evidence.details: I began exploring Kimi seriously in 2026. I used it to compare a long collection of project notes, public links, and evidence. The most useful behavior was keeping the main question coherent while separating supported facts from claims that still needed proof.

evidence.title: ProofPack production build
evidence.details: I designed and deployed ProofPack, a private evidence workspace powered by Kimi K2.5. It returns an answer, facts used, warnings, missing proof, and a confidence score instead of only polished prose.

evidence.title: GitHub Copilot Dev Days
evidence.details: I helped organize a hands-on AI-assisted coding workshop for developers and students.

evidence.title: Claude Community Meetup
evidence.details: I supported event operations, participant experience, and practical AI learning sessions.

evidence.title: AI-assisted video production
evidence.details: I produced short-form brand content using a repeatable research, scripting, editing, and review workflow.

evidence.title: Miro Meetup
evidence.details: I helped run a collaborative design and facilitation meetup for a mixed audience.

evidence.title: Observability build report
evidence.details: I documented what changed after replacing a dashboard-first approach with a question-first observability workflow.

evidence.title: Cloudflare deployment practice
evidence.details: I deployed several small community and evidence tools on Cloudflare Workers and Pages.

evidence.title: Monad Blitz
evidence.details: I contributed to hackathon delivery and participant coordination.

evidence.title: Solana CO_HACK
evidence.details: I supported a developer-focused hackathon session and community engagement.

evidence.details: My responsibilities include registration curation, speaker coordination, run-of-show, content, and post-event reporting.

evidence.details: I keep project links, event records, articles, and metrics together so that every public claim can be checked.
